features: Easy to use electric throw with push button controller, with 4 heat settings and 4 -hour auto-shut off function for peace of mind
Lush and silky royal posh material for ideal warmth and comfort, stylish black color
50" x 60", ideal size to snuggle up in
Makes a great accessory while relaxing on couch, bed or your favorite chair

description: Snuggle up with the Sunbeam Royal Posh Ribbed Heated Throw to beat those winter chills. Indulge yourself with its lush and silky royal posh material to keep you toasty all night long or warm as you unwind. Easy to use detachable controller with 4 heat settings and a 4-hour auto-shut off feature for peace of mind. Remove the controller and place the blanket into the washer and dryer for easy cleaning.
